ambient_events: A pallet ziggurat sheds a plank from its summit and no one flinches.
The wet-timber smell of Pallet Row gets into the back of your throat.
description: Wooden pallets stacked into unstable ziggurats, splintered, stained, and endlessly recirculated. The whole row smells of wet timber and the ghost of whatever they last carried.
name: Pallet Row
